concerns.text: The plan runs Shapiro‑Wilk normality tests on `anxiety_score` and `control_proxy` separately and selects Pearson vs. Spearman based on those p‑values. Acceptance Criterion AC‑008 (and AC‑009) require the Shapiro‑Wilk test to be performed on the *residuals* of the regression (or on the joint distribution), not on each marginal variable. This mismatch means the plan does not satisfy the specified statistical methodology.
